meta.titleEn: Grape Leaf Dried Extract 180 mg Capsules (Venous Circulation Medicine)
meta.actionKo: 만성정맥부전으로 인한 다리 부종·무거움·통증을 개선하는 포도엽 제제입니다.
meta.actionEn: A grape leaf preparation that improves leg swelling, heaviness, and pain caused by chronic venous insufficiency.

4887aeb2.symKo: 만성정맥부전으로 인한 하지부종, 하지중압감, 통증의 개선
4887aeb2.symEn: Improvement of lower-leg swelling, heaviness in the legs, and pain caused by chronic venous insufficiency
4887aeb2.pointKo: 만성정맥부전에 의한 다리 부종·무거움·통증에 쓰는 약입니다.
4887aeb2.pointEn: A medicine for leg swelling, heaviness, and pain from chronic venous insufficiency.

bc9f9f55.watchKo: 과민증, 소아·청소년, 포도당-갈락토오스 흡수장애(캡슐제), 임부·임신 가능성 여성, 수유부 복용 금지
bc9f9f55.watchEn: Do not use with hypersensitivity, for children and adolescents, with glucose-galactose malabsorption (capsules), if pregnant or possibly pregnant, or while breastfeeding

en.4887aeb2: This medicine is used to improve lower-leg swelling, a feeling of heaviness in the legs, and pain caused by chronic venous insufficiency.
en.d4ed593b: Adults take 2 capsules (360 mg) per 1 dose, 1 time a day, before breakfast with water.
en.6ede8c9f: Do not take this medicine for more than 3 months.
en.bc9f9f55: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, are a child or adolescent, have glucose-galactose malabsorption (applies to capsules), are pregnant or may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.
en.18eadd55: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are a woman who may become pregnant.
en.b6415291: Consult a doctor or pharmacist if the following occur: rarely, hives, skin rash with or without itching, skin hypersensitivity reactions on sun exposure, or eczema; very rarely, angioedema; rarely, gastrointestinal reactions such as stomach pain, nausea, or diarrhea, headache, or sudden unusual symptoms in one leg or severe pain, swelling, skin discoloration, tightness, or a feeling of warmth.
en.26a0091e: If symptoms do not improve even after taking this medicine for about 6 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
